title: Bound on a folded maximum
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list of nonnegative integers, let $f$ map nonnegative integers to nonnegative integers, and let $B$ be a nonnegative integer. If $f(a)\le B$ for every $a$ in $l$, then the maximum formed by folding the values $f(a)$ over $l$, starting from $0$, is at most $B$.
